title: FMMS Telemetry Envelope
description: Canonical wire format for sensor measurements published by the sensor fleet over MQTT and forwarded onto the Kafka 'telemetry.{shard}' topics by the ingestion gateway. See architecture.md §7.1 for evolution rules.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Backward-incompatible changes get a new minor or major and a new topic.

sensor_id.description: Stable identifier for the sensor. Bound to area_id in geo-service.

area_id.description: Geographic area the sensor belongs to. Used as the Kafka partition key.

ts.description: Sensor-side timestamp (UTC, ISO 8601). Subject to clock skew; see architecture.md §7.3. The ingestion gateway adds a server-side `ingested_at` separately.

mode.description: Sensor-side mode flag. Drives transmission frequency at the sensor (FR-10). The system also makes its own classification in the rule engine.

measurements.description: Sensor readings. All numeric fields are optional (a sensor may not host every transducer), but at least one must be present.

rainfall_mm_h.description: Cumulative rainfall over the last reporting window, normalized to mm/hour.
